Riley (Marketing): Quick sync: final checklist for Optimize launch blog. Need headline, UTMs, embed link to bench artifact, hero image, legal ok, and publish owner. Target Fri 10am PT.
Zoe (Growth): Headline options: A) 'Reduce serving cost by up to 4x with Redwood Optimize' B) 'Lower inference bills with smarter batching'. Lean A for conversion.
Tom (PM): Bench stat = up to 4x vs baseline float32 on A100, 8k context. I'll attach method note. Use 'up to' wording.
Ethan (Eng): Confirmed bench csv in release/artifacts/optimize/bench-2026. Recommend linking to artifact rather than embedding raw numbers.
Ivy (Design): I'll upload hero_og.png (1200x630) and hero_blog.png (1600x900). Reminder: blur internal metrics.
Leila (Legal): Remove competitor names and absolute claims. Anonymize any customer quotes. Embargo okay?
Riley (Marketing): Yes embargo Thu 23:59 PT. Will send press list.
Zoe (Growth): UTMs: campaign=optimize_launch, source=blog, medium=organic. If testing CTAs add utm_content=ctaA or ctaB. Example: https://redwood.com/webinar-register?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=ctaA
Tom (PM): CTA routing: primary -> webinar (HubSpot form id=50). Secondary -> demo (Calendly link). Map tag 'optimize_launch' for both.
Jon (Sales): Confirmed. Webinar leads -> webinars queue, SLA 24h. Demos -> AE task created.
Ivy (Design): Uploaded publish-safe images. Alt text added.
Ethan (Eng): Added one-line "how we measured" under chart. Link to artifact included.
Leila (Legal): Reviewed edits, anonymized quote, approved.
Riley (Marketing): Who will publish and queue socials?
Zoe (Growth): I'll publish and schedule X + LinkedIn. Will run A/B headline test.
